audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3]/late/wants.you[2] call Gold Card 'a slow projectile you sidestep' — Pick a Card empowers his next basic attack; a targeted auto cannot be sidestepped. The right play is giving ground before he closes to attack range while it's locked. The W auto-reset burst tell (missing interaction) was absent, and the cooldowns field had no digits (W 6s, Q 6s, R 170/140/110).
audit.why: Riot text: 'Twisted Fate chooses a magic card... and uses that for his next attack'; autoReset flag on W. Packet suspectName on 'Gold Card' is a false positive on the name itself (Gold Card is the standard term for W's yellow pick) — the defect is the sidestep claim, not the name.
audit.corrected: Sidestep claims replaced with give-ground-while-locked advice; auto-reset wind-up cue added to tradeBad; real cooldowns added.

notes: Chart: full sides moved to match content and packet exactly (Vex rows 0-4 and 6; row 5 stays Skill — no no-op side edit written for it, only its why was fixed since the Luden's template contradicted the even first-item verdict both other sources give). Real mechanical fix: Gold Card was described as a sidesteppable slow projectile — Pick a Card is his next basic attack, targeted, undodgeable by movement; advice now is to give ground while it's locked. The packet suspectName ('Gold Card' -> 'wild cards') is a false positive on the name — Gold Card is the standard term for W's yellow pick; the sentence's mechanics were the defect. W auto-reset wind-up tell (missing interaction) folded into tradeBad/report[3]. TF has no lane dash (R Gate only), so the dash-fear trade templates were replaced with card-timer play. breakdown.spikes/feeding remain templated; nothing TF-specific to add without invention.
